decision_points.question: what minimum data volume must a sample have before its estimate is kept?
decision_points.why_rival: each sets the row/event threshold below which the analysis is discarded; an analyst picks one rule

decision_points.question: what minimum size must the extreme-comparison subsample reach before it is fit?
decision_points.why_rival: sole gate on whether the extreme-contrast sub-analysis proceeds

decision_points.question: how is the effect estimate's confidence interval obtained by resampling the observed data?
decision_points.why_rival: each is a variant of nonparametric resample-and-refit percentile bootstrap for the effect CI

decision_points.question: how is the effect estimate's confidence interval obtained by simulating from the fitted model's parameters?
decision_points.why_rival: each redraws model coefficients from their asymptotic distribution to build the effect CI/p-value; distinct from data-resampling bootstrap (which it co-occurs with as a separate check)

decision_points.question: how is the unadjusted/crude association estimated and tested?
decision_points.why_rival: each is a rival descriptive route to the raw exposure–outcome association (Wald RD, Wald SEs, 2x2 OR, chi-square)

decision_points.question: how is the hypothesis-support conclusion (p-value or decision rule) derived?
decision_points.why_rival: each is a different rule for turning the estimate/bootstrap distribution into a supported/unsupported verdict or p-value

decision_points.question: on what scale is the adjusted model's effect summarized?
decision_points.why_rival: marginal risk difference via g-computation versus odds ratio are rival summary measures of the same fitted model

decision_points.question: what regression specification estimates the adjusted exposure–red-card association?
decision_points.why_rival: linear probability, mixed-effects logistic, covariate-adjusted logistic, and full-sample primary model are rival models for the binary outcome

decision_points.question: how is the skin-tone exposure contrast defined for estimating the effect?
decision_points.why_rival: quartile extremes, fixed-cutoff extremes, tercile extremes, or keep the full continuous sample are mutually exclusive ways to frame exposure

decision_points.question: how are the skin-tone rating categories collapsed into exposure groups?
decision_points.why_rival: sole choice about merging the medium category into dark

decision_points.question: what threshold defines agreement between the two skin-tone raters?
decision_points.why_rival: sole definition of the rater-agreement criterion

decision_points.question: is the model refit on only the rater-agreeing dyads as a sensitivity check?
decision_points.why_rival: sole decision to restrict the estimation sample by rater agreement

decision_points.question: which dyads enter the inter-rater reliability check?
decision_points.why_rival: sole decision to require both raters present for the reliability computation

decision_points.question: how are player positions collapsed into categories?
decision_points.why_rival: both settle the position-bucketing scheme; an analyst uses one categorization

decision_points.question: how is the fitted model's calibration / goodness-of-fit assessed?
decision_points.why_rival: decile predicted-vs-observed binning and the Hosmer-Lemeshow test are rival goodness-of-fit checks

decision_points.question: does the outcome regression include a free intercept or is it forced through the origin?
decision_points.why_rival: sole choice about the intercept term

decision_points.question: how is the outcome distribution family selected?
decision_points.why_rival: sole procedure comparing Poisson versus binomial by AIC

decision_points.question: how is the random-effects structure selected?
decision_points.why_rival: sole procedure selecting the random-effects specification by likelihood-ratio test

decision_points.question: how is moderation modeled on the regression right-hand side?
decision_points.why_rival: sole choice about adding rater-by-moderator interaction terms

decision_points.question: what prior is placed on the latent rating-class probabilities?
decision_points.why_rival: sole choice between independent Uniform priors and a joint simplex prior

decision_points.question: which covariate subset is displayed in the diagnostics table?
decision_points.why_rival: sole choice of the key_vars display subset

decision_points.question: what negative-control/falsification outcome is used?
decision_points.why_rival: sole choice to substitute yellow cards as a negative-control outcome

decision_points.question: how are out-of-range linear-probability predictions checked?
decision_points.why_rival: sole robustness rerun restricting to in-bounds LPM predictions

decision_points.question: are the previously-excluded single-game dyads included in the analysis?
decision_points.why_rival: sole choice about re-including single-game dyads

decision_points.question: is the adjusted effect re-estimated within a restricted subset of leagues?
decision_points.why_rival: sole choice to refit within selected leagues

decision_points.question: which data file is loaded as the analysis sample?
decision_points.why_rival: sole choice to load the pre-cleaned maindata.dta as the full sample
